summary: Fixed all five deduplicated R01 review groups (C1-RV-01..05) on build da30003 with genuine RED->GREEN regressions at API/DB/WS and React-container seams. Durable rejected-attempt receipts, uncertified transient failures, open-socket grant lifetime enforcement, join revision/publish, stale HTTP/WS rejection, truthful Live, one operation key per uncertain join, and per-question outcome state are implemented. Current-build regression: Mode A 71 pass / 0 fail; Mode B rebuilt Docker-only stack with migration 0002 and a separate Docker test runner 71 pass / 0 fail; both-mode restarts keep data and receipts. C1-01..C1-14 and C1-16 PASS on this build; C1-15 PARTIAL because real-browser interaction remains NOT RUN (no browser automation available). No old R01 PASS was copied forward.

findings.fix: One tab-scoped join operation key per room; uncertain retry reuses key and payload, nickname edits reuse it, a different room code is an explicit new join; server join idempotent per (session, join_key).
findings.limitations: Exercised through real react-dom containers in happy-dom with stubbed transport, not a real browser.
